title: Tools & Woods
description: More tools and Greenwood wood type included.
body:
![Absurd Minecraft: Tools & Woods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5937e5d86cdcd63655377ce5d51135b50a3bc2f5.png)
Absurd Minecraft adds more ores, tools and wood to the game such as Ruby, Bluestone and Greenwood.

Greenwood cannot be obtained yet.

Ruby, Bluestone and Amethyst tools all use Iron's presets but look cooler.

Ores generate from Y level 1 to -63
